summary: Phase 19 cross-platform integration (PRISM pubs-by-author on FACULTY+, ALUMNI mentor-match on Student Assistant, COMPASS AQAR live totals) tested end-to-end. 15/15 backend pytest cases pass on /app/backend/tests/test_phase19_integration.py covering PRISM token-split heuristic (basic match, Dr-stopword drop, empty/only-stopword returning [], cross-tenant 403), ALUMNI mentor-match scoring (branch=CSE+role=SDE, AIML/ML availability filter, limit=1, cross-tenant 403), and COMPASS preview (C3/C5/C7 new metric keys, extended totals object, A+ band score, freeze persistence). Frontend FACULTY+ Profiles tab shows 3 expandable faculty cards — clicking faculty-prof-pubs-toggle-fac-38e7ba16c3 expanded the panel showing PRISM publications list (Deep Learning for IIoT · IEEE TII · 2024 · Hari, Sundar · 42 cited) and toggle text flipped to 'Hide publications(7)'. Collapse works. Student Assistant mentor-recommendations-panel renders with ALUMNI360 badge, defaults CSE/Software Engineer, clicking mentor-match-btn returned 3 cards (Ravi · 53.5 · CSE '19 · SDE-III · Google). Changing to ECE/Embedded and re-matching returned 3 different-score cards (3.5). After page reload, branch='ECE' and role='Embedded' persisted via localStorage. COMPASS /compass-aqar UI renders composite score 75 → A+ grade; C3 panel shows publications=10, total_citations=252, h-index=8, patents_granted=3, active_grants_value=75₹L; C5 shows placement_drives_total=3, applications_total=2, selected_total=0; C7 shows renewable_energy_share + carbon_footprint; narratives correctly include h-index, patent, drive, selected and renewable.

issues: Pre-existing recurring warning 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' from Recharts ResponsiveContainer. Cosmetic, non-blocking, not Phase-19 related.

critical_code_review_comments: PRISM /publications-by-author token-split correctly drops stopwords (dr/dr./prof/prof./mr/mrs/ms/the/and/of) and tokens <3 chars (filters initials like 'S.'). Substring matching is case-insensitive on any author entry. Correct heuristic, no false positives observed.

ALUMNI /mentor-match scoring: +50 exact branch, +30 role-or-company substring, +0.5/year experience capped at +10. Output sorted desc; verified Ravi scored 53.5 with CSE+SDE (50 + 0 + 3.5 yrs experience) and 3.5 with ECE+Embedded (no match, only experience). Available-only filter enforced.

COMPASS AQAR composite score logic (+5 for ≥5 pubs, +5 for ≥20% renewable, governance baseline reduced from 15→10 to keep max=100) lifts VCE to score=75 → A+ band as expected. Freeze captures totals into compass_aqar collection with audit event written.

FacultyPlus.jsx FacultyRow uses local state to fetch /publications-by-author lazily on first toggle click — good for perf. Toggle text correctly reflects count in parens after fetch (verified 'Hide publications(7)').

StudentAssistant.jsx MentorRecommendations persists branch + role to localStorage on every match — verified by page reload retaining ECE/Embedded inputs. Default values CSE/Software Engineer applied only when localStorage empty.

Module-gating regression (PRISM disabled in /admin/modules) not retested — note: API /publications-by-author is intentionally NOT module-gated, only the /prism route page is. Acceptable per problem-statement note.

Seed data observation: only CSE alumni appear to be seeded as mentors. ECE/AIML mentor-match returns CSE alumni with low (experience-only) scores. Not a bug — scoring works correctly, but consider seeding diverse-branch alumni for richer demo.

Token-split heuristic correctly drops 'Dr' prefix so 'Dr Hari' query matches seeded author 'Hari'. Mentor scoring produces deterministic ordering.
